description: Auditable waivers for PR Quality guard (guard-pr-quality.js) ratchet violations. The guard remains BLOCKING by default; a violation is only waived when a valid, non-expired waiver entry exists for the exact file. Expired waivers FAIL LOUDLY (they do not silently pass) to prevent permanent bypass. Each waiver requires an explicit reason and owner approval.

waiverSchema.allowedLines: integer (required) - maximum permitted line count for the file (baseline + accepted growth)
waiverSchema.approvedBy: string (required) - owner identifier who approved the waiver
waiverSchema.baseline: integer (required) - merge-base line count at time of waiver (documents what was accepted)
waiverSchema.expiresAt: string (required) - ISO 8601 timestamp; waiver FAILS after this date (no silent permanence)
waiverSchema.pr: integer (optional) - PR number this waiver was granted for (audit trail)
waiverSchema.reason: string (required) - human-readable justification; must reference the specific work (e.g. P1 finding IDs, PR scope)
